scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('index.html')) process.exit(1); console.log('Static build verified: index.html');"
scripts.lint: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const html=fs.readFileSync('index.html','utf8'); const m=html.match(/<script>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/); if(!m) process.exit(1); new Function(m[1]); console.log('Syntax check passed');"
